[EN] Habere used to be a village of hope.

Each day brings more reason to doubt, though.
[ES] Habere solía ser un pueblo de esperanza.

Aunque cada día trae más motivos para dudar.

[EN] I've had just about all I can take.
[ES] Ya he tenido más de lo que puedo soportar.

[EN] It looks like I'm not going to get any hunting done this month!
[ES] ¡Parece que no voy a poder cazar nada este mes!

[EN] Oh, are you looking for an aman?
[ES] Oh, ¿estás buscando a un aman?

[EN] We can't control everything.
[ES] No podemos controlarlo todo.
